title: Lumbopelvic ratio L/P during backward extension from upright, IMU
condition: healthy, standing, upright to maximal backward extension

quantity.name: lumbopelvic ratio L/P
quantity.definition: total lumbar rotation / total pelvis rotation at 10% steps of full trunk backward extension (cumulative)

source.sample: 22 young healthy male students, no recent back/hip/knee complications

protocol.summary: Maximal voluntary primary RoMs in standing measured with 4 inertial sensors.
how_to_use: For backward extension beyond upright (not the return from flexion), L/P rises from 1.4 to 2.3: pelvis leads early, lumbar later.

measurement.device: Xsens MTx inertial sensors (4) on T1, T5, T12 and S1 spinous processes
measurement.task: slow (4-5 s) maximal voluntary flexion, extension, left/right lateral bending, left/right axial rotation from relaxed upright, 3 trials

extraction.from: Results 3.2 (text); full 10-interval curves only in Supplementary materials 4 (not available)
extraction.check_notes: Only the end values (10% and 100% intervals) are given in the paper text.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
